verdict.rationale: Parsec lists 'Virtual monitors' and 'Multi-monitor streaming (Up to 3)' as its own features. This implies it can create extra host displays beyond the physical one and stream them to a client device, rather than only mirroring the main screen. The evidence is only a bare pricing-page line, though. Nothing describes a tablet or spare device acting as an extended second display alongside the host's own screen. Missing for 10: documentation of virtual-monitor behaviour (extend vs mirror), explicit tablet or spare-device-as-second-screen workflow, which client platforms support it, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
